snippet.title: Cult of PiN | Gameplay Trailer
snippet.description:
Cult of PiN is a Roguelike Pinball game where the tables are possesssed and it's your job to destroy them, repeatedly. Complete missions, equip upgrades and pull off trick shots to trigger devastating special attacks. Bumper-smashing fun all round.

Wishlist on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3144340
Try the Demo on Itch.io: https://kennymakesgames.itch.io/pin
